main_text.l: Spiritui Sancto refistitis. Vnde dura cervix in illo
populo, qui ex omni mundo electus est; qui de ser-
vitute decem miraculis meruit liberari; cui lex da-
ta est; cujus salutis ora Prophetarum omnium mi-
litarunt; ex quo factus secundùm carnem, & ad
quos missus est Christus: nili, quia cæcitas ex parte
in Israël facta est; donec Israël adoptatus, ex pleni-
tudine gentium, intraret in regnum: & conclusit
in incredulitate omnes Dominus; ut omnes indig-
erent misericordiâ Salvatoris? Cujus divini consilii
sacramenta perstringens, & majestatis myste-
rium, quæ quàm vis magnitudine revelationū no-
verat; tamè pro humanâ infirmitate succubens, et
iam ille, qui, pro persecutionibus & blasphemiis,
vas electionis meruit nominari, miratus, exclamat:
O altitudo divitiarum sapientiæ & scientiæ Dei! & in-
scrutabiles vias ejus, & inscrutabilia confitens Dei
esse judicia. Cum illo ergo, quàdo de talibus quæ-
ritur, admiremur: & manente sententiâ, quod
non sit iniquitas apud Deum; si quid est illud, quod
quæritur, quod modum nostri sensus excesse-
rit, & intellestus nostri non dignatur angustias:
in illâ justitiæ, misericordiæ, præscientiæq; divi-
næ plenitudine, permanere inconcussâ æquitate

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "gētibus" (first word, cut off from the previous page, the e may carry a macron); "nili" printed as such (probably for "nisi"); "tamè" as printed. The word "succubens" is read with some uncertainty. Show-through from the facing page is visible at the top and was left out. The word "fatea-" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The text carries no printed page number or running head on this scan.
